_instructions: Fill this in with the rates and contact details each studio gave you. Nothing here is a real rate until you enter it. Each room looks like {"name": "Studio A", "rate": "$__ / hour", "minimum": "__ hours", "includes": ["engineer", "..."]}. booking_email is where the bot sends requests. booking_contact and referral_wording are what the artist sees once a person taps Available. Update rates_as_of whenever the studio changes its rates, then run /setup-studio again.
